translation_source: TRTR Tomb Raider (2013) Hungarian v1.0 package supplied in references/saját.

import.record_id_mapping: Resource-local translation-memory ordinals only; not game record IDs. Original TMX tuid retained as legacy_tuid.
import.context_preserved: All original TMX note attributes retained in legacy_context; blockNo and time are not unique identifiers.
import.matching: Source language and exact source text, normalizing CRLF/LF and legacy XML newline literals only; conflicting translations are rejected.

supplemental_russian_source.reason: Imported into the same hu.json with per-entry source_language=ru. The legacy program routed CINE dialogue marked as Russian to the Russian-source TMX provider.

nearest_git_reference.basis: The Tomb Raider KnownGame profile and AppId/BigfileVersion fields agree with the decompiled binary; exact binary-to-commit identity is not established.

notes: The decompiled KnownGames.cs confirms the target game is Tomb Raider (2013), Steam AppID 203160, TIGER v3.
The EXE PDB path points to the TRTR Git source tree but does not prove an exact source commit.
The historical package build claim and current Steam build have not been verified against game files.
Experimental TIGER v3 and text handlers now pass copy-based binary checks; the historical hu.json remains a non-installable source-text memory.
The package PDB identifier differs from the archived source.zip Debug executable PDB identifier.

verification.location_fields: Aligned byte offset; bits 0..3 part; bits 4..10 priority.
verification.override_resolution: Highest priority for exact (hash, locale); equal-priority ambiguity rejected.
verification.boundary_evidence: bigfile.000.tiger size 2147458360 exceeds the historical 0x7FF00000 limit. The experimental 0x80000000 ceiling fits observed parts; no original file was rewritten.
verification.language_profile: English subtitle slot 0 and archive locale bit 1; English/neutral archive families exclude Japanese. Explicit family and exact locale retained; include_overridden exposes menu layers.
verification.legacy_language_behavior: TRGameInfo.TransTextLang is English. BigFileList derives TransVoiceLang from localized archives and rejects multiple different localized families; it is not a universal build/language policy.

identifiers.menu: Table slot ordinal in the extracted build.
identifiers.cine: block ordinal * 65536 + occurrence within the selected language.
identifiers.sch: Ordered English segment occurrence; timestamps and prefixes are context only.
identifiers.resource: (archive family, hash, exact archive locale) for explicit physical layers; the default view still resolves priorities.

verification.translation_issue: Three historical control-placeholder errors are corrected only in the local Steam test package, in 13 positions across five menu layers. The maintained historical import remains unchanged.
verification.support_status: experimental; Hungarian menu confirmed in game; double-acute font supplement installed with verified recovery; font appearance and subtitle gameplay verification pending
verification.installed_archives_write_authorization: User explicitly authorized working in the Steam Tomb Raider directory and supplied Tomb Raider.orig as the recovery copy.

original_recovery_copy_verified.comparison: Exact sizes and SHA-256 before Steam installation.

verification.initial_gameplay_observation: User reported English main-menu text both through Steam and the initial copy launcher; no scene or subtitles were tested and the running executable path was not captured.
verification.menu_layer_correction: The initial effective-resource view translated only patch3, which has no New Game, Continue, or Options records. The revised local package explicitly targets all five English menu layers.

steam_installation.status: restored before glyph-trial installation; first recovery data preserved

verification.menu_gameplay_observation: User reported that the menu works correctly, but lowercase ő/ű display as boxes. Uppercase Ő/Ű and subtitle scenes have not been separately verified.

glyph_trial_preflight.source: Supplied historical TR.hu.trtr/info.xml; package contains no font asset and decompiled FontFile.Translate is empty.

all_records_rebuild.method: rebuild in memory from original copy; no game writes

verification.glyph_trial_gameplay_observation: User confirmed circumflex glyphs; boxes resolved, correct Hungarian double acute glyphs remain unsupported.

font_supplement.method: Existing O/U base contours and duplicated acute accents; existing circumflex codes and glyph indices retained.

font_assets.format: DRM v22 reference-free DTP bodies containing GFX DefineFont3 outlines
font_assets.source: Original game font outlines, amended locally using their own base letters and acute accents; no external font was introduced.

user_verification.result: User confirmed the repaired font is attractive and works everywhere they encountered it; font task closed.
user_verification.scope: Observed locations; not exhaustive coverage of the full game.

font_assets.stream_placement: Rebuilt NEXT chain and fresh nonoverlapping virtual ranges; assets contain no fixed installation offsets.
font_assets.source_text_identity: hu.json remains a source-text translation memory. Bind to fresh records before installation. The binding preserves fonts and the binding script copies their assets. Current Unicode font assets have no font-specific character substitutions; older verification reports describe historical circumflex assets.
font_assets.recovery: Original nested font bodies and changed index ranges are preserved by the shared transaction.

steam_9573671_supplement.method: AI-assisted translation and bilingual source review; not an addition to the historical human translator credits.
steam_9573671_supplement.source: Existing read-only Steam 9573671 extraction; exact source bytes retained in hu.json.
steam_9573671_supplement.empty_source_handling: 11 empty subtitle sources and 4 space-only menu sources remain untranslated; original data retained.

legal_review.scope: Complete paragraph-aligned translations; dates, numbers, legal qualifications, references, URLs, email addresses and subclauses checked. Source-era provisions were not modernised.
legal_review.reviewer: AI assistant; independent legal-professional review not performed.
legal_review.duplicate_terms: A single source-text memory unit supplies identical translations for physical entries 848 and 849.
legal_review.translated_form_labels: Human-readable bracketed insertion instructions in the cancellation form were translated; they are not runtime variables.
preserved_source_anomalies: General Privacy Notice: Press Centre registration cites influencer recruitment as its lawful basis.
Terms section 16 excludes reasonably foreseeable losses; this unusual affirmative wording was retained.
Terms section 18(B) defines England as including Scotland and Northern Ireland for that paragraph; retained.

verification.copy_scope: Only patch3 menu; existing packaged fonts retained in the final bound document, not re-tested by the menu-only cycle.
verification.in_game_verification: Pending for supplemental translations and the legal document viewer.

embedded_font_layer_selection.reason: The base bigfile collection contains older, different decoded bodies for the same embedded IDs; the verified replacement assets target the shared patch/title bodies.
embedded_font_layer_selection.gui_catalog_build_scope: Steam build 9573671; historical source-text hu.json retained separately

in_game_verification.scope: User reviewed the new build-specific translation batch in game and reported it looked good.
in_game_verification.limits: Confirms reviewed in-game appearance only; the separate Windows Setup dialog still shows circumflexes for Hungarian double-acutes, and linguistic proofreading plus unreviewed screens and line-wrapping cases remain open.

current_steam_state.verification_method: User reported completed GUI restoration followed by translation available for installation; not a fresh independent whole-installation hash audit.

comparison_with_historical_translation_m.result: Neither source is a subset of the other. The Epic export is retained as the canonical English archive export; hu.json remains a separate source-text translation memory.

unicode_text_policy.status: All active Hungarian circumflex substitutions removed; user reported successful installation, accent appearance, restoration and renewed install availability.
unicode_text_policy.scope: Interface and subtitles both retain real Unicode double-acutes at runtime. Global and font-specific substitution maps are empty. Existing per-entry substitution-disabled directives remain valid.
unicode_text_policy.preserved: Source text, translations, metadata, control tokens, font payloads and recovery backups are unchanged. Historical substitution records below describe previous stages, not current policy. Legacy glyphs remain in fonts for compatibility, but are no longer generated by text substitution.
unicode_text_policy.verification: 49 targeted font, document and translation-memory tests passed.

user_verification.result: User reported correct TR2013 accents after installation, then completed GUI restoration and observed translation available for installation again.
user_verification.final_acceptance: The user rechecked TR2013 on 2026-10-26 and reported that all accents were correct. Issue #7 was closed as completed after this confirmation.
user_verification.limits: User-observed cycle and final accent acceptance, not an independent byte-exact restoration audit, complete linguistic review or exhaustive font-consumer inventory. The separate package-update GUI recovery defect was fixed in commit d6fdd15324847a7a8c942db0c28528df528059cd.

unicode_menu_update.status: menu-only Unicode update installed; targeted binary readback passed; wider appearance review pending
unicode_menu_update.user_feedback: User accepted the targeted Setup/in-game experiment as perfect on 2026-10-26
unicode_menu_update.scope: Only menu entries containing Hungarian double-acutes disable substitution. All translation text, source text, metadata and subtitle policy are unchanged. Legacy circumflex glyphs remain usable by subtitles.
unicode_menu_update.verification_scope: Existing font/package verification reports describe historical circumflex assets. Unicode aliases are covered by the new candidate report and targeted user trial; no exhaustive game-wide appearance claim.
